title: Fixing the forum post
subtitle: Yumei has no glycerin
intro: He only meant to reply "utter nonsense". But the post has been bumped, and the wrong thing is being repeated.
closing: He knows pharmacology well and often mixes into answering questions. More people slowly come to ask him, and he starts thinking about harm reduction.
threadTitle: [Help] Can Yumei really be used as glycerin?

posts.author: OP
posts.body: Only today did I learn that [[e1]]. So can Yumei also be used as glycerin?
Don't talk nonsense above. Someone also says [[e2]] -- is that true?
My friend says [[e3]]. He's been taking it for half a year.

posts.author: Gotō
posts.body: ...You people really aren't afraid to die.

e1.right: That is guaifenesin, not glycerin. One character different in the name, a whole chain different in the substance.
e1.wrong: Gotō: You didn't even read the name right, and you dare put it in your mouth?

e2.right: No. You can't o on sertraline; serotonin syndrome will make you wish you were dead.
e2.wrong: Gotō: Who told you it was fine? Bring that person here too.

e3.phrase: pregabalin and amantadine are fine together
e3.right: Never combine them. Don't use "he's been taking it for half a year" as evidence; half a year is not proof of safety.
e3.wrong: Gotō: Your friend not getting hurt only means his luck hasn't run out yet.
